other_conditions: Applicant must be unemployed (not employed in government, private sector, or self‑employed) and not a dismissed government employee
Must be a bonafide Himachali and registered with any Employment Exchange in Himachal Pradesh at the time of application
Must be enrolled in a skill development training programme
Family annual income (including spouse’s) must be less than Rs 2 lakhs for the financial year preceding the application
Applicant must not have been convicted of an offence resulting in imprisonment of 48 hours or more
In case of a widow, age limit is below 45 years
benefits_summary: Provides a monthly allowance of Rs 1,000 (Rs 1,500 for persons with at least 50 % permanent disability) for up to two years to eligible educated unemployed youth.
documents_required: Attested copy of 8th/matriculation marks sheet or certificate
